title: Supplementary data for: Hydrothermal carbonization-assisted dewatering of cattle manure digestate: compression mechanisms and phosphorus and potassium partitioning
description: Supplementary material (Online Resources 1 and 2) for a study of hydrothermal carbonization (125.9-294.1 °C, 39.5-140.5 min, 1.59-18.41% total solids) of cattle manure digestate followed by piston-press dewatering (50-200 bar). Includes the full central composite design dataset, press data, solid and process-water analyses (ash, VS, pH, EC, TOC, TN, K, PO4), FTIR spectra, SEM micrographs and point EDS compositions.
